value.syntax: # [doc = " CDDL refused as an assigned theory."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Every arm refuses a *source*, never a document: a theory that does not"] # [doc = " parse, references a rule nothing defines, falls outside the assignable"] # [doc = " fragment, or uses a control operator this implementation does not"] # [doc = " evaluate is not the kind of thing `Theory::parse` takes. Whether a"] # [doc = " document satisfies a theory is a verdict and travels as a value."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " [`TheoryError::Unevaluable`] is a specified outcome rather than a"] # [doc = " shortcut: whether a host processes a given theory's CDDL is the host's"] # [doc = " policy, and a reader that will not process an assigned theory holds"] # [doc = " neither it nor anything above it in that major."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{Theory, TheoryError};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let err = Theory::parse(r#\"e = {0 => \"com.example\", 1 => [0, 0, uint], 2 => missing}\"#)"] # [doc = "     .expect_err(\"nothing defines `missing`\");"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!(err, TheoryError::UnresolvedRule { ref name, line: 1 } if name == \"missing\"));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug , thiserror :: Error)] # [non_exhaustive] pub enum TheoryError { # [doc = " The source is not acceptable CDDL."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The parser's own refusals arrive here, and so do the two defects the"] # [doc = " grammar admits but a rule table cannot: a name defined twice with"] # [doc = " different expressions, which RFC 8610 §3.1 calls an error in as many"] # [doc = " words, and a generic instantiated at an arity its rule does not"] # [doc = " take. All three are located the same way, because a consumer"] # [doc = " reporting them cannot tell which pass raised them."] # [error ("CDDL syntax error at line {line}, column {column}: {detail}")] Syntax { # [doc = " 1-based line."] line : u32 , # [doc = " 1-based character column."] column : u32 , # [doc = " What was wrong, in a sentence."] detail : String , } , # [doc = " A reference to a rule the theory does not define and the standard"] # [doc = " prelude does not supply."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " A socket — a name beginning with `$` or `$$` — never lands here:"] # [doc = " RFC 8610 §3.9 makes an undefined socket the empty choice rather than"] # [doc = " a missing definition."] # [error ("unresolved rule reference {name:?} at line {line}")] UnresolvedRule { # [doc = " The reference as it was written."] name : String , # [doc = " 1-based line of the reference."] line : u32 , } , # [doc = " The theory parses and resolves, but is not a sentence of the"] # [doc = " assignable fragment."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The detail opens with the line the refusal was located at: the"] # [doc = " variant carries no structured location of its own, and a fragment"] # [doc = " refusal without one would be unlocatable in a consumer's diagnostic."] # [error ("theory is not in the assignable fragment: {detail}")] NotInFragment { # [doc = " Which clause failed, and where."] detail : String , } , # [doc = " The theory uses a control operator outside the evaluable subset."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Never raised for the *type* at a content key, which the fragment"] # [doc = " leaves free: a theory refused here is in the fragment and would be"] # [doc = " evaluable by an implementation covering more of the vocabulary."] # [error ("theory uses {operator}, which this implementation does not evaluate")] Unevaluable { # [doc = " The operator as it was written, leading dot included."] operator : String , } , # [doc = " A `.regexp` pattern the crate cannot use."] # [error ("`.regexp` pattern is not usable")] Regexp (# [from] RegexpError) , # [doc = " Two theories offered for comparison differ in label or major."] # [error ("theories differ in label or major and are not comparable")] Incomparable , }
